# Project Domain Knowledge

This skill provides the domain context needed to generate code that correctly models the business.

## How to Use This Skill

1. Start with `entity-glossary.md` to understand the core domain entities, their definitions, and relationships.
2. Refer to `bounded-contexts.md` to understand service boundaries, ownership, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
3. Use this knowledge to ensure generated code respects domain boundaries and uses correct entity names, relationships, and business rules.

## Quick Reference

- [Entity Glossary](entity-glossary.md) — all domain entities with their definitions, owning services, and key relationships.
- [Bounded Contexts](bounded-contexts.md) — service boundaries, responsibilities, and inter-service contracts.
